invariant: CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity converts the source note position through Position.withRankdir before it constructs the note Link. TOP_TO_BOTTOM leaves every position unchanged. LEFT_TO_RIGHT rotates RIGHT to BOTTOM, LEFT to TOP, BOTTOM to RIGHT, and TOP to LEFT. The converted position controls link orientation, length, horizontal-solitary status, lines0 membership, rank-same emission, and therefore Graphviz topology. EntityImageNote later chooses its painted callout side from the solved note-side contact; the source keyword is not reused as an unrotated layout constraint.
causal_divergence: Rust preserves the source NotePosition correctly in the parser but also uses that raw value directly when adding attached-note SVEK edges and when locating the solved edge during rendering. In left-to-right diagrams this supplies the topology Java would use for a different source position. The independent follow-up's four-note probe demonstrates the exact rotation: Rust's source-left note occupies Java's source-top geometry, source-right occupies source-bottom, source-top occupies source-left, and source-bottom occupies source-right. This is a direction-model error, not a node-order or paint-side constant error.
planned_change: Add one direction-aware attached-note layout-position transform derived exactly from Position.withRankdir. Apply it when constructing every attached-note layout edge and when carrying the position into solved-edge lookup/rendering, while retaining the original parsed source position in the diagram model. Add a four-position left-to-right regression plus top-to-bottom controls. Do not alter note dimensions, spacing, edge lengths, callout geometry, or comparator tolerances.
perturbation_axes: source position: left, right, top, and bottom
target ownership: root entity versus direct package leaf versus nested descendant
note cardinality: one note versus multiple notes on one or several targets
declaration order: grouped positions versus interleaved targets
